The '''Czerka Weapons Division''' was a major division of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]] that produced weapons. [[Eva Kaayz]] was chief operations officer of the division at the time of Czerka's nationalization by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
